description: Source file implementing GStreamer metadata handling for Rialto EME Protection Metadata, including initialization, freeing, type registration, and adding protection metadata to buffers.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_init
methods.description: Initializes the GstRialtoProtectionMetadata structure, setting info to NULL.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_free
methods.description: Frees the GstStructure info if it exists and sets it to nullptr.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns the GstMetaInfo for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds GstRialtoProtectionMetadata to a GstBuffer with provided GstStructure info.
